channel.title: Family Packages on YumFam
channel.description: Recent content in Family Packages on YumFam

item.title: Hangzhou Xianghu Kaiyuan Grand Hotel + Theme-Park Bundles from ¥499 (≈$70)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night superior room + breakfast + kayak/Xianghu cruise for 2 — ¥499 (≈$70) · 2 nights deluxe terrace room + breakfast + dining credit — ¥888 (≈$125) (was ¥2,188, 41% of list) · Valid Sep 11 – Dec 31, 2026 · usable any day of the week

Inside Xianghu National Tourist Resort in Xiaoshan, the Kaiyuan Grand sells mix-and-match bundles: a lakeside night plus your pick of kayaking, a Xianghu cruise, Senbo Water Park / Fantasy Island tickets, or Changqiao Polar Ocean Park + kids’ park tickets — with a free 2-hour hanfu experience, a kids’ DIY craft session, welcome fruit, heated pool, gym and parking thrown in.

item.title: Jing-Jin-Ji Attraction Annual Pass from ¥42.5 (≈$6) — 150+ Beijing, Tianjin & Hebei Sights
item.description:
Deal price: annual pass (standard), 1 card — ¥42.5 (≈$6) · 2 cards — ¥85 (≈$12) · Premium pass — ¥95 (≈$13) · Supreme pass — ¥189 (≈$27) (was ¥298, 63% off) · Buy-and-use, refundable anytime

The 2027 Jing-Jin-Ji tourist annual pass (electronic version) unlocks 150–170+ attractions across Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei: Beijing Aquarium (with zoo access), Beijing Wildlife Park, Phoenix Ridge （凤凰岭）, Juyongguan Great Wall, the CCTV Tower, Mangshan Forest Park, Lianhuashan Ski Resort and many more. A single Beijing Wildlife Park ticket normally costs more than the whole pass.

item.title: Conghua Tianrenshanshui Camp Resort, Guangzhou — Tent/RV/Cabin Stay + Meals + Art Park & Lake Cruise ¥499 (≈$70)
item.description:
Deal price: 1-night camp stay + meals + park tickets — ¥499 (≈$70) (was ¥699, ~29% off) · Valid Oct 13, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027, usable daily · Refundable anytime

A proper outdoorsy family escape in Guangzhou’s Conghua hills: the Tianrenshanshui Valley Camp （天人山水度假区·溪谷营地） Double-11 promo packs one night in your choice of sailing tent, safari tent, Chinese-style RV (bunk beds) or wooden cabin, plus breakfast and a proper dinner for two (fish-head hotpot with Xufu braised rice at 清集市）, Earth Art Park tickets for 2 adults + 1 kid, a Shaxi reservoir sightseeing cruise and the shuttle bunny cart. Mornings come with free mindfulness exercise (yoga / baduanjin), middays with a free sound-bowl meditation session, and weekends and holidays add a nature-study activity (3 options, for 2 adults + 1 kid).

item.title: Foshan Metoo Sports Theme Park — 10,000㎡ Sci-Fi Play Arena: 1 Adult + 1 Kid 3-Hour Pass ¥188 (≈$26)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid, 3 hours of play — ¥188 (≈$26) · All-day solo ticket from ¥138 (≈$19, was ¥198) · Buy-and-use, refundable anytime

A rainy-day (or scorching-day) lifesaver for families in the Greater Bay Area: METOO HOME PATRY （万民店） is a 10,000㎡ sci-fi-themed sports arena across two floors, with 11 themed zones and 60+ immersive activities — trampolines, slides, ball pits, climbing and high-energy interactive games — pitched at everyone from age 3 to 50. The 3-hour parent–kid pass even allows multiple re-entries on the day of visit.

item.title: Xiamen Science Museum — Multi-Hall Tickets from ¥80 (≈$11): Main Hall + Sea Monster + Kids' Zone + Cinema
item.description:
Deal price: multi-hall tickets from ¥80 (≈$11) · 4-hall adult ticket ¥139 (≈$20) / discounted ¥119 (≈$17) · Valid Oct 13 – Nov 30, 2026 · Tuesday–Sunday only · Buy-and-use, refundable anytime, auto-refund on expiry

The Xiamen Science Museum （厦门科技馆， 95 Tiyu Road, Siming — inside the Xiamen Culture & Arts Center) is a classic family day out, and these combo tickets bundle its headline halls at a discount. The 4-hall ticket covers the main exhibition hall, the Sea Monster exhibition, the kids’ zone and the flying cinema; the current Mars exhibition is the star draw. One combo even includes the Chengyi Nature Exploration Museum halls for a full multi-museum day.

item.title: Changtai Banyue Mountain Hot Spring — 1 Adult + 1 Child Ticket from ¥189 (≈$27), Any Day
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child hot-spring ticket — ¥189 (≈$27) (was ¥399, 48% off) · Bookable Jun 23 – Dec 31, 2026, any day of the week · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Hidden in a forested valley in Changtai （长泰半月山温泉）, about an hour’s drive from Xiamen, Banyue Mountain is a strontium-rich soda spring （富锶苏打汤泉） done in wild-luxury style — soaking pools tucked into mountain woodland rather than concrete blocks. One ticket covers 1 adult plus 1 child, usable weekdays and weekends (open 13:00–23:00).

item.title: Anji Hello Kitty Castle Hotel — 1 Night + 2-Day Unlimited Theme Park Entry, from ¥699 (≈$98)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 2 Hello Kitty Park adult tickets with 2-day unlimited entry — ¥699 (≈$98) (was ¥1,098) · Currently bookable and reservable (the merchant page shows no end date — book while it’s live)

The Anji Yinjun Jinjiang Castle Hotel （安吉银润锦江城堡酒店， 8 Tiandao, Anji, Huzhou) is every kid’s fantasy base camp: a literal castle with a covered walkway straight into Hello Kitty Park, and the headline package includes adult tickets with unlimited re-entry across 2 days — arrive Friday afternoon, play Friday and Saturday, and never queue twice.

item.title: Xiamen Fantawild Holiday Hotel — 1 Night + 2-Day Park Tickets for 2, from ¥999 (≈$141)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 2-day unlimited park tickets for 2 — from ¥999 (≈$141) (was ¥1,399, ~29% off) · Bookable Sep 16 – Oct 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

A turnkey theme-park weekend for two: the Xiamen Fantawild Holiday Hotel (同安区石浔南路1111号), a newly opened family hotel ranked among Fujian’s top 20 family resorts, bundles a 1-night stay with breakfast and unlimited 2-day entry for 2 to Dream Kingdom (梦幻王国) or Oriental Heritage (东方神画) — Xiamen’s answer to the Disney two-day playbook, minus the flight.

item.title: Wuyuan Mingyu Hotel — 1 Night by a 4A Scenic Area + Breakfast from ¥299 (≈$42)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a Huizhou-style courtyard hotel + breakfast, from ¥299 (≈$42) (was ¥699, about 43% of list) · Bookable through Dec 31, 2026, weekends included · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

A first for this site: Jiangxi’s Wuyuan — the “most beautiful countryside in China” county, famous for its rapeseed fields and white-walled Huizhou villages. Mingyu Hotel sits right inside the Wangkou 4A scenic area, wrapped by two rivers, built as a Huizhou-style courtyard with the classic “thousand-gold gatehouse, four-tael house” (千金门楼、四两屋) layout. The hotel even has its own Hui-carving art museum by master Yu Youhong, with an interactive experience zone and evening guided tours (8:00 pm).

item.title: Xiamen Monster Power Sports Park — Indoor Play: Trampolines + Climbing Tower, 1 Adult + 1 Kid ¥89 (≈$13)
item.description:
Deal price: one ticket, four zones, all-day play — from ¥59 (≈$8) (was ¥188, about 32% of list) · Bookable through Oct 15, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Oct 15, 2026

When the autumn rain hits Xiamen, this is the kind of place you’ll be grateful for: a 4,000㎡ indoor sports playground over two floors, right at Huli Park metro (Line 4 exit). One ticket gets you into all four zones with 40+ activities — a full-category trampoline arena, the Monster Cube climbing tower, the Monster Grid zone, plus a crawling-pet and cute-pet house — with no time limit on the day ticket.

item.title: Shanghai Lingang Ice-Snow Mingcheng Hotel — 1 Night + 2 All-Day Snow-Play Tickets, ¥799 (≈$113)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast + 2 all-day snow-play tickets — from ¥799 (≈$113) (was ¥1,598, 50% of list) · Bookable Oct–Dec 2026, weekends/holidays usable with ¥100 surcharge · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Real snow in Shanghai: this Lingang bundle pairs a 1-night superior room with daily breakfast at the Ice-Snow Mingcheng Hotel with 2 all-day unlimited snow-play tickets at the Yaoxue Snow World next door — the tickets are valid across 2 days, so you get two full snow days — plus complimentary hot-spring tickets thrown in. Guests note the tickets alone nearly pay for the room.

item.title: Xiamen Jimei Guole Park — 14-Ride Family Ticket for 2 Adults + 2 Kids, ¥149 (≈$21)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 adults + 2 kids 14-item ticket — ¥149 (≈$21) (was ¥168; single gate ticket from ¥39.9 / ≈$5.60) · Buy-and-use, no reservation needed · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

A 40,000㎡ outdoor treasure for young kids in Xiamen’s Jimei district: Guole Park bundles gate entry + 11 rides + 3 animal-feeding experiences into one 14-item ticket. Petting zones, classic carnival rides, and wide-open running space — the whole family’s afternoon sorted. Buy-and-use with no reservation, refundable any time, and auto-refund if it expires.

item.title: Xiamen Lingling Hotel — 1 Night + 2 Circus Tickets + Animal Kingdom Access, ¥599 (≈$84)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfasts + 2 circus tickets + Animal Kingdom — from ¥599 (≈$84) (was ¥1,930, about 31% of list) · Bookable Oct–Dec 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

The full Xiamen show-and-zoo weekend in one ticket: 1 night (deluxe twin or king) at Lingling Hotel with 2 breakfasts, 2 standard seats to the Lingling circus (any session you like), and unlimited Animal Kingdom sightseeing for the whole stay — pandas, parrots, the lot. The package refunds automatically if it expires and is refundable any time before you reserve.

item.title: Hangzhou Yuan Exploration Hall — 1 Adult + 1 Kid 2-Visit Card ¥399 (≈$55)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid 2-visit card ¥399 (≈$55) (was ¥776 — 48% off) · Hangzhou-resident monthly card ¥399 · ⏰ purchase & activate by Nov 30, 2026; card valid 3 months after activation

An 8,000㎡ indoor high-tech discovery space built for rainy-day parenting: Yuan Exploration Hall mixes exhibits with hands-on engineering play. The headliner is a real car, disassembled to show every part, plus a station where kids assemble their own cars from blocks and test them on three different slides. The 3rd floor has a family rest cabin — a detail parents appreciate.

item.title: Huzhou Longemont Dreamland — Theme-Park Hotel Stay from ¥479 (≈$67)
item.description: Deal price: ¥479 (≈$67) for 1 night + breakfast + 2 park tickets (pick one of three) · + Grand Circus guest seats ¥659 (≈$92) · Park tickets + skiing ¥659 · 2 nights + 2 parks + circus ¥1038 (≈$144) · 2 nights + animal world + performance city + skiing ¥1038 · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

item.title: Hangzhou Rotten Apple Land — Family Theme Park Tickets from ¥99.9
item.description:
Deal price: ¥99.9 (≈$14) single ticket · 1 adult + 1 kid ¥129.9 (≈$18) · family (2 adults + 1 kid) ¥199.9 (≈$28) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Rotten Apple Land (烂苹果乐园) sits right across from Hangzhou Paradise in Xiaoshan — an indoor-style family park built around high-tech rides, live performance shows, and kids’ career-play zones. Think “mini Disneyland” vibes for a fraction of the price. One ticket-buying adult can bring one child under 1.1m free. Note: under-3s and kids under 1m can’t do about half the rides, so it’s best for ages 3+.

item.title: Qiandaohu Pure Fun Resort — 2 Nights + Full Board from ¥499
item.description:
Deal price: ¥499 (≈$69) for 2 nights · 3 nights ¥599 (≈$83) · 4 nights ¥799 (≈$110) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Pierre & Vacances (法国太阳季) opened this new resort at Qiandaohu, and the deal is the full-board play: 2 nights with daily breakfast + lunch + dinner, a free upgrade to a family/parent-child room (limited availability — book early), plus the resort’s full set of stay rights. Stack nights and the per-night price drops fast: ¥249/night on the 2-night, ¥200/night on the 3-night and 4-night packages.

item.title: Beijing Tangquan Liangzi Sauna — 16-Hour Hot Spring & Sauna from ¥19.9
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥19.9 (≈$2.75) for a 16-hour child ticket · Adult 16-hour ticket ¥79.9 (≈$11) · Adult + body scrub ¥139.9 (≈$19) · Adult + 40-min lobby foot massage ¥169.9 (≈$23) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Tangquan Liangzi at Shougang Park is a 6,000㎡ hot-spring and sauna complex spread over three floors — soak in the pools, hit the saunas, and stay as long as you like, because the ticket covers 16 hours (open 00:00–02:00). Toiletries are provided, and beyond the baths there’s a kids’ play area, a PS5 gaming zone on the 6th floor, and hanfu costume try-on with photo spots — a very family-friendly setup for a sauna. Buy and use immediately (no reservation needed, show your Xialv voucher code + phone number at entry), and it’s refundable anytime before use.

item.title: Guangzhou Star River Hotel — Near Chimelong, Buy-1-Get-1 2 Nights from ¥999
item.description:
Deal price: ¥999 (≈$138) for 2 nights (buy 1 get 1) · Castle river-view family room ¥669 (≈$92) · Room + buffet breakfast & dinner ¥949 (≈$131) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off + ¥50 welcome bonus

Star River Hotel sits on Panyu Avenue in Guangzhou — the go-to base for a Chimelong trip. Every package includes a 55㎡ city-view room, daily breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids (kids under 1.2m), two swimming pools, and a free shuttle to and from Chimelong. Breakfast extras: free under 1.2m, half price 1.2–1.5m (¥97), full price above 1.5m (¥193); dinner free under 1.2m, half (¥128) and full (¥238) tiers.

item.title: Wuhan Kaiyuan Senbo Resort — Autumn Harvest Stay: 1 Night + 2 Waterpark/Fantasy Island Tickets, from ¥699
item.description:
Deal price: ¥699 (≈$97) (was ¥1,988 — 3.6折, 64% off) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Wuhan’s Kaiyuan Senbo — an all-in-one waterpark-and-fantasy-island resort in Caidian District — is running its autumn-limited “Harvest Battle” event. One night in a superior garden-view room, 2 buffet breakfasts, and 2 single-day tickets of your choice: the indoor water park or Fantasy Island (the indoor kids’ park). The package also throws in travel photography (3 retouched photos + a 15-second video), welcome fruit, mini-bar drinks, free self-service laundry, non-slip socks for Fantasy Island, and free locker use at the water park. Reserve by 19:59 on the day of use; refundable before use. Note holiday surcharges: +¥300/room-night on Mid-Autumn (Sep 25–26) and Oct 1, +¥500 on Oct 2–5, +¥200 on Oct 6.
